warnings: Spread footings, no piles. main_bar.count is the two-way total (section 6b); each footing is square, so depth_mm is omitted.
Depths below ระดับดินเดิม (1.00 to the footing top, then the footing, 0.05 lean concrete 1:3:5 and 0.05 compacted coarse sand) are printed against a level with no value, so they stay on the elements.

PS (precast plank floor) detail: topping mesh is main_bar (RB6@0.20 or wiremesh 4 mm), the RB9@0.40 L-bars at the slab end are additional_bars. Total 0.05 + 0.05 read from the two stacked 0.05 dimensions at the right edge.

PS live load: this detail prints 'รับน้ำหนักบรรทุกจรได้ไม่น้อยกว่า 200 กก./ตร.ม.' while the A-01 general notes print 150 กก./ตร.ม. — the member detail wins (op01 precedence), 200 kept on PS; the conflict is recorded in the notes file too.
